claude.note: The native harness: Claude Code has no command that lists models, so this is captured by hand from claude --help. Its --model takes an alias for the latest model of a line or a model's full name (the help gives the aliases fable, opus and sonnet as examples; haiku is the alias Aether's agents already use) and its --effort takes low, medium, high, xhigh and max. Each id is the Claude API id the alias resolves to.

models.excluded: The owner keeps Fable out until Fable 5.5 (decision A43).

muse.note: model/list of muse serve 1.4.14, asked over MSP with the owner's login and no model call: source providerCatalog, four models, of which muse-wonder-1.0 is the session's default. The first three list minimal to max; muse-spark-1.2 stops at xhigh. On 2026-10-19 (muse 1.4.10) the listing held only muse-wonder-full-1.0 and muse-spark-1.3 entered by the owner's decision as a model called but not listed (A94); the CLI lists it now, and muse-wonder-1.0 too (issue 108).
